Identification_Area.title: Map of Moon Landing Sites for Surveyor, Apollo, and Luna Missions

Citation_Information.description: This map locates the landing sites of the Surveyor, Apollo, and Luna missions to the Moon. Created by D. R. Williams of the NASA Space Science Data Coordinated Archive, this graphic has a full resolution of 75 x 75 pixels per inch (1100 x 1070 pixels).

External_Reference.reference_text: Davies, M.E., and T.R. Colvin, Lunar coordinates in the regions of the Apollo landers, Journal of Geophysical Research, Volume 105, Issue E8, pages 20,227-20,280, 2000.

Document.acknowledgement_text: Document provided by the NASA Space Science Data Coordinated Archive (NSSDCA, formerly NSSDC).
Document.description: This map of Moon landing sites has full resolution of 75 x 75 pixels per inch (1100 x 1070 pixels). It is in public domain and was downloaded from the NSSDCA at http://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov.
